subject: Data Engineering
title: Column-Family Stores
description: A quick, practical guide to Column-Family Stores.

hook.text: Cassandra handles 400,000 writes per second across the globe. How? Column-family architecture.

buildup.text: Column-family stores like Cassandra and HBase group columns into families optimized for specific queries.

discovery.text: Data is partitioned across nodes by a row key, enabling massive horizontal write throughput.

twist.text: Reads by non-key columns are slow. You must design your table around your query patterns.

climax.text: Column-family stores power time-series data, IoT telemetry, and messaging at planet-scale.

punchline.text: Design the table for the query, not the data.

quiz.question: What are column-family stores optimized for?
options: High write throughput with queries by row key
